posts.title: Week 104 — How is it November already
posts.description: What the post title says! Mum came to visit for Sebby's birthday last weekend (30 Oct — 1 Nov). She had bought Sebby a balance bike (which I nearly had to go pickup from Adelaide ;) but instead got to pick up from around the corner). Sebastian has been pretty obsessed with motorbikes ever since he heard and saw the neighbour's bike. Every time they're out and he hears it start, he wants to go out
Have been having a blast shooting film again recently! The first 2 are Kodak Gold 400 in a Canon AV1. The last 2 are Kodak Portra 400 (unsure how long they were expired?) in Clare's Pentax full frame
